first_pass_reviewers.isolation: runs in a separately isolated agent context that does not share reasoning, notes, intermediate labels, or output with pass-beta until both passes have independently completed all 4,516 candidates
runs in a separately isolated agent context that does not share reasoning, notes, intermediate labels, or output with pass-alpha until both passes have independently completed all 4,516 candidates

adjudicator.role: resolves every disagreement between pass-alpha and pass-beta with a recorded rationale and final label; does not itself produce a first-pass label; remains blind to any detector output because none exists at labeling time

review_roles.independence_disclosure: All three roles are AI sessions, not human reviewers. This satisfies the protocol's requirement for two independent first-pass labels plus a distinct adjudicator; it is not represented as human review. Sequential passes by one AI task are explicitly insufficient under this protocol and are not what this record authorizes.

labeling_rules.no_silent_conversion: ambiguous and insufficient_source labels are never silently converted to a pass or a fail
labeling_rules.no_sampling: every one of the 4,516 corroborated candidate loci receives a first-pass label from both pass-alpha and pass-beta; no subset, stratum, or top-N cutoff is substituted for the full denominator
labeling_rules.blind_to_detector: no detector has been executed and none of the three roles may consult detector output; this record itself is written before any labeling begins

deadline.basis: approximately five calendar days from this commitment, consistent with the owner's stated days-scale target; adjustable only by a superseding, equally pre-registered capacity commitment recorded before labeling completes

public_claim_boundary: This record commits review capacity and a deadline; it makes no detector-quality, precision, recall, calibration, or release claim, and does not itself authorize detector freeze or untouched execution.
